name: dsh-memory-vault
description: Knowledge and memory vault for DSH: nested memory groups with automatic summarization, free assignment between conversation memory and the knowledge base, priorities, a base-prompt layer, and AI curation. The core is host-free and shared by the DSH plugin, a CLI, and a loopback RPC server, so DSH, Codex, and any Node host call the same vault.

scripts.test: node --no-warnings tests/smoke.mjs && node --no-warnings tests/core-smoke.mjs && node --no-warnings tests/serve-real.mjs
